title: Async Function Suspension & Microtask Resume
description: Trace how await suspends an execution context and resumes via the Microtask Queue.

steps.label: 1. Synchronous Prologue
steps.description: async fn() runs synchronously on the Call Stack until it hits await.

steps.label: 2. Suspend & Return Pending Promise
steps.description: Engine pops fn() off the Call Stack, saves its frame on the heap, and returns a pending Promise to the caller.

steps.label: 3. Enqueue & Resume Microtask
steps.description: When fetchJSON() settles, the resume reaction enters the Microtask Queue and restores fn() on the Call Stack.
